notes.text: Read from the DP map of Sandgem Town (560 x 368 px); the tile grid starts 8 px in from the left edge, as on the route maps.
Buildings are blocked; each door is the tile walked into, on the building's front row. A fence runs west from the lab along row 6 to the map edge.
Exits: west rows 7..9 (Route 201); north (20..29, 0) (Route 202); south (20..25, 22) (the beach, Route 219, offset not known).

Walking south from Route 202 (30, 22) stops at (29, 2) above the Poke Mart; walking west from there stops at (20, 2). The lab's sign stands on row 7, in front of the fence: walking west along row 7 stops at it.

Joins: the 16 px strip at the right of the Route 201 image matches the left of this image, putting column 0 on Route 201's column 64; rows are 3 px apart, so the row comes from the edges: the lab fence (row 6) lines up with the fence post at the right of Route 201's row 3, and Route 201's open rows 4..6 meet rows 7..9 here (offset 3).

Route 202's image bottom matches this image's top 16 px to the right, so Route 202's column x + 1 is above column x here (offset -1); its open bottom row (25..30, 25) meets (24..29, 0). The 8 px overlap leaves a half-row doubt.
